description: Marks a conversation's flow done, as the flow chip's Mark done does. conversationFlowId names the flow when the thread has more than one. outcome (for example declined) closes it early without marking its steps done; close_note is optional. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: close_conversation_flow
title: Mark a conversation's flow done
